_comment: Injecticide organisation AI policy template (injecticide-org-policy/v1). Keys that start with '_' are comments and are ignored by the validator. Replace every value with your organisation's own text. The organisation below is fictional.
_organization: Your organisation's name, as it should appear in scan reports.
_policy_name: A short name for this policy.
_compiled_date: The date this JSON was compiled from the source documents, written YYYY-MM-DD.

sources._comment: One entry per source document the rules come from. 'id' and 'title' are required; 'version', 'date', 'owner', 'url' and 'notes' are optional text.
sources.title: Example Widgets AI Use Policy

rules._comment: Required: id, title, source (a sources[].id), requirement, when, effect, enforcement. Optional: section, approver (required when effect is require_approval), rationale.
rules.title: No credentials stored in skills
rules.requirement: Skills must not contain passwords, API keys or tokens.
rules.rationale: Credentials in a shared skill can be copied by anyone who receives it.

rules.title: Personal data needs a data protection review
rules.requirement: Skills that carry personal data need approval from the data protection officer.
rules.rationale: Personal data processing must have a recorded lawful basis.

rules.title: Only approved web destinations
rules.requirement: Skills may only contact services on the approved list.
rules.rationale: Unlisted destinations have not had a supplier review.

rules.title: Scripts are reviewed before use
rules.requirement: Skills that run code or install packages need an engineering review.

rules.title: Skills declare an owner
rules.requirement: Every skill names an accountable owner in its metadata.

rules.title: Internal staff directory is permitted
rules.requirement: Business contact details of staff may be used for internal routing.
rules.rationale: Business contact data is covered by the staff privacy notice.

not_statically_checkable._comment: Requirements from the source documents that a static scan cannot check. They are listed in the report so nobody assumes they were checked.
not_statically_checkable.requirement: Users must review AI output before sending it to customers.
not_statically_checkable.reason: This is a behaviour at run time, not something in the skill package.

verification_notes: Compiled from AIUP 2.1 and DPS 4.0. Rules R1 to R6 were checked against the source text by the policy owner.
